resources.string: Share your cycle, send doodles and leave little surprises for each other!
Encrypted file from afar or Bluetooth nearby.
Nothing syncs automatically. Each exchange is started by you.

1. Scan your partner’s invitation and confirm the code
2. Show your invitation for your partner to scan. Compare the numbers on both screens - they must match
3. Scan your partner’s updated invitation
4. Done - on success you’ll see "Connection confirmed"!
Show this invitation, then scan theirs.
Your confirmation is in this QR code. Let them scan it, then scan their updated invitation.
Both phones must confirm the same code. Scan the updated invitation to finish connecting. Data exchange stays unavailable until then.
You can now exchange data and little messages. Your next exchanges will check the trusted keys automatically.
For a new connection with a short verification code, update Ritela on the other phone. Existing trusted contacts keep working.
Draw a postcard, leave a message or plan a little surprise.
Shared information will appear here after you receive an exchange.
